entities.summary: Pedro Aznar (b. 1959-07-23, Buenos Aires) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Buenos Aires and Argentina. Known in the fields of argentina, composers & musicians, americas.
